page.overview:
What is Porco Kingdom?

The Porco Kingdom is a nation somewhere in the Grand Line.

Nothing is known about the country's geography because it has yet to make an appearance.

The only known citizen of the Porco Kingdom was Ginny, when she was a young child.

51 years ago, Ginny was born in the Porco Kingdom.
